shipped.title: Omadesign 0.6.9 · Export what you placed
shipped.summary: Released a fix for 0.6.8, where a document with ICC-tagged placed photos and a layer effect such as Drop Shadow failed every export. PNG, JPEG, TIFF, SVG, PDF, PSD, PSB, ORA and IDML exports now work from the app and from the command line, and export never changes the document. Pull request 491 merged later the same day.
bullets: Placed and imported artwork converts to the document color model and profile
Raster layer effects render in precise exports instead of refusing
Existing documents export as they are
shipped.when: Nov 7 · 5:11 AM EST release, 3:55 PM EST merge

links.label: Pull request 491 · export placed photos with effects

shipped.title: Omadesign 0.6.10 · Effects in every color space
shipped.summary: Released a follow-up that fixes a color bug in 0.6.9, which rendered effected layers through 8-bit sRGB and clipped wide-gamut color. Shadows, glows and overlays are now built in the document profile, group and clipping effects render, and CMYK effect colors convert into each ink. Pull request 492 merged the same afternoon.
bullets: Placed artwork now also matches the document bit depth
JPEG from tagged RGB documents embeds the document profile
Float documents export 16-bit PNG; CMYK documents export PNG and JPEG
SVG, PDF, ORA, IDML and AI upscaling use a temporary 8-bit sRGB copy
shipped.when: Nov 7 · 6:37 AM EST release, 3:55 PM EST merge
